operational_meaning: Airport-hour node that receives source records.
The GDP interval begins at 12:26 UTC and contributes 34 active minutes to the 12:00-13:00 UTC hour.
Active-overlap minutes become the normalized state impulse.
The impulse updates the DCSI state through the selected recovery memory.
Surface-weather fields remain context variables and supply no action impulse.
Scheduled arrivals and arrival-bank intensity remain workload context variables.
Parsed advisory reason text maps the action to a semantic constraint family.
